name: Dundalk Leisurecraft Serenity MP Barrel Sauna Canadian Timber 4 Person | CTC2245MP
description: Description This Canadian Timber Serenity Barrel Sauna with 18 in (45cm) Porch is handcrafted from Eastern White Cedar with a breathtaking full glass front and upper back window . The door is 0.2 in (5mm) bronze tempered glass with wooden frame and pre-hung on the front wall for easy installation. This Sauna kit comes with solid cedar cradles, aluminum bands with stainless steel hardware and is packaged in a ready to assemble kit . This model features a built in front porch with benches so you have a covered cool down area on the outside of the sauna. The round concept of the barrel sauna makes it unique and very efficient to heat as well as encourages proper air flow during sauna use. Features Seats: 2-4 people Size: 7' Diameter x 7.9' Long incl 1.5' porch Cubic Size: 285 ft³ ( 8m³ ) Wood: Eastern White Cedar Walls: 1.5" thick solid Cedar Door: Full-Sized Door with Bronze-Tempered Window for Easy Access Weight: 1277 lb Shipping Dimensions: 96 x 45 x 34 Made in: Canada Includes Includes: Full sauna kit: Pre-cut tongue & groove white cedar for full sauna structure 2x Solid benches 2x Bronze tempered full length front glass windows Half moon bronze tempered back glass window Aluminum Bands Door w/ bronze tempered glass window Flat removable floor Porch with 2 seats Hardware Installation guide & video Heater sold separately Choose a matched heater package in the heater options on this page, or contact us if you'd like a different heater. Sauna Accessories Add a Cold Plunge Tub , Outdoor Shower , Backrests , Bucket & Ladle , Lights , Thermometer , and Sand Timer to create the ultimate relaxation haven.
